Questions
Thank you so much for agreeing to speak with me today!
My name is Alena, and I'm a Product Manager on the pdfFiller team.
My goal today is to better understand your experience with pdfFiller -- what tasks you typically
perform and how you use the product - so we can better tailor it to our users' needs.
Feel free to be open - there are no right or wrong answers. If there’s anything you find
frustrating about pdfFiller, please don’t hesitate to share. You won’t hurt my feelings -- our main
goal is to learn from you.
Before we begin, would it be okay if I record our conversation? The recording will only be used
internally for note-taking purposes.
Business context, use cases
· What made you start using pdfFiller?
- Was there a specific problem you were trying to solve?
· To start, can you tell me, do you use pdfFiller for personal or work-related tasks? Or
maybe both?
o Personal: what are these tasks you need to do
· Professional: Can you tell me about your role and the type of work you do?
o What kind of documents are part of your day-to-day work?
· What made you start using pdfFiller?
o Was there a specific problem you were trying to solve?
· In what kinds of business situations do you turn to pdfFiller?
o Urgent approvals? Customer paperwork? Internal processes?
· Can you walk me through a recent task or workflow you completed using pdfFiller?
What kind of document was it?
o Who else was involved (colleagues, clients, partners)?
o What were the steps from start to finish?
· What kind of documents do you work with most often in pdfFiller?
o Forms, contracts, internal docs, something else?
